carpet.rule.noCreeperGrief.name: No Creeper Grief
carpet.rule.noCreeperGrief.desc: Creeper explosions no longer destroy your terrain.
carpet.rule.missingToolsPlus.name: Missing Tools Plus
carpet.rule.missingToolsPlus.desc: More tools can serve as effective tools for mining glass.
carpet.rule.lavaStrider.name: Lava Strider
carpet.rule.lavaStrider.desc: Depth Strider also works in lava (swim fast! :D)
carpet.rule.xaeroMapName.name: Xaero Map World Name
carpet.rule.xaeroMapName.desc: Requires the client to run Xaero's World Map. Solves map data mixing on proxy networks (BungeeCord / Velocity).
carpet.rule.villagerTradeSwiftSneak.name: Villager Trade Swift Sneak
carpet.rule.villagerTradeSwiftSneak.desc: Allows librarian villagers to sell Swift Sneak enchanted books.
carpet.rule.villagerTradeWindBurst.name: Villager Trade Wind Burst
carpet.rule.villagerTradeWindBurst.desc: Allows librarian villagers to sell Wind Burst enchanted books.
carpet.rule.forceRestock.name: Force Restock
carpet.rule.forceRestock.desc: Shoot a villager with a spectral arrow to force it to restock.
carpet.rule.villagersAttractedByEmeraldB: Holding an emerald block attracts nearby villagers.
carpet.rule.limitPillagerPatrolSpawn.des: Pillager patrol spawning is affected by the mob cap.
carpet.rule.infinityBowNoArrows.name: Infinity Bow No Arrows
carpet.rule.infinityBowNoArrows.desc: Bows enchanted with Infinity can shoot non-consuming arrows even with an empty inventory.
carpet.rule.leashableMinecarts.name: Leashable Minecarts
carpet.rule.leashableMinecarts.desc: Minecarts can be leashed and pulled around like boats.
carpet.rule.villagerTradeRefresh.name: Fake Player Librarian Trade Refresh
carpet.rule.villagerTradeRefresh.desc: Values false/vanilla/force: vanilla lets a fake player break and replace a lectern to reroll trades; force rerolls directly on the server (setOffers+getOffers), much faster. Both require an untraded villager.
carpet.rule.witherSkeletonNoStoneSword.d: Wither skeletons no longer drop their stone sword. Bones, coal and skulls are kept.
carpet.rule.grindstoneEnchantmentDuplica: Copies the enchantments of the item in the bottom slot onto the top item (recreates the 24w10a-24w11a snapshot feature, no experience cost).
carpet.rule.endGatewayExitSearchDistance: How far an End gateway looks radially outward for its paired return portal on first teleport. 0 = vanilla (1024 blocks); >0 = custom (e.g. 768). After changing, use /Gatewayfixer to re-pair existing portals.
carpet.rule.autoRestock.name: Fake Player Auto Restock
carpet.rule.autoRestock.desc: Based on schematic material demands (reported by the client or set via /Itemfetcher demand), fake players automatically withdraw materials from registered stock chests. Register chests with /Itemfetcher stock add first.
carpet.rule.restockIntervalTicks.name: Auto Restock Interval
carpet.rule.restockIntervalTicks.desc: How many game ticks between each gap scan and dispatch. Default 20 (1 second).
carpet.rule.itemFetcherPrefix.name: Restock Fake Player Prefix
carpet.rule.itemFetcherPrefix.desc: The restock fake player's name is the prefix + fixed suffix 'fetch' (the default 'flt_' gives 'flt_fetch'). One shared bot per server; no player name is included. Clamped to 16 chars (the vanilla player name limit); a longer name makes the server fail to encode player_info_update and kicks the client.
